mechanism: Isoniazid may inhibit hepatic metabolism and increase olmesartan exposure; olmesartan may reduce isoniazid efficacy through altered renal clearance and potential hyperkalemia risk with ARBs affecting isoniazid levels.
action: Monitor blood pressure control and renal function (potassium, creatinine) periodically; ensure adequate TB treatment response; consider baseline and follow-up potassium levels given concurrent use.
